title: Lights Race
hook: Everyone gets the same board of lights: switch them all off first, while your friends' boards flicker beside yours.
prompt: a lights out puzzle race with friends, each on our own board

controls.primary: press the light you point at: it and its four neighbours switch

round.winBy: first to switch every light off

world.notes: A five by five board of lights on the paving; each player sees their own board there.

mechanics.as: a board of lights of your own

rules.summary: Everyone gets the same board of lights. Press a light: it and the lights beside it switch on or off. Your score is how many lights are off on your board; the first to switch every light off wins. Alone, bots race you on boards of their own.
rules.scoring: your score is how many lights you have switched off; the first board cleared wins

characters.describe: a round jelly-bean kid at the board

accept: each friend's board is drawn live beside mine, in their colour, with their name
a friend's press shows on their board on my screen as they make it
the first board with every light off wins
